record_type_quote: The present study aimed to reproduce findings by Yiend et al. (2015), which identified an unexpected pattern in those with GAD: faster disengagement from angry faces compared to positive (happy, neutral) faces. The present study recruited a larger (nonclinical) sample from a student population to achieve greater statistical power.
